_comment: Answer keys for the Video-MME items shown in this demo, so the viewer can say whether a run was right. Published deliberately: these are already public in the lmms-eval/Video-MME dataset, and the reason phase 0 hides them is agent isolation, not secrecy. On the lab machine this file is mode 600 so the agent user cannot read it during a run - see scripts/setup_agent_user.sh.
_note: Only benchmark items have keys. Demo questions and live questions have none.
